verdict.rationale: Datadog documents a public API reference [datadog-docs-24], an official MCP server [datadog-docs-3, datadog-probe-3], and an official CLI [datadog-probe-4], so programmatic access clearly exists. Nothing in the pack shows the API matches everything the UI can do, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found at the standard probed paths [datadog-probe-2]. The CLI (datadog-ci) also appears CI-focused rather than a general UI-equivalent surface. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage across all UI features (dashboards, monitors, SLOs, incidents, etc.), a discoverable OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on confirmation of API/UI parity.
